note: Bookshop (1): books, pages, notebooks and readers. The tall bookcase-pillar in the middle divides it: feminine nouns on its left, masculine on its right. The left doorway goes back to the first general shop; the right doorway leads on to the fashion boutique. Zoom: the reading desk in the left half.
